composition.from: per-100 g values computed from the printed panel by dividing each printed figure by 0.12, because the panel's own declared basis is 12 g of powder made up with 100 ml of water (water adds no nutrients): 6.4/0.12 = 53.3 g fat, 1.8/0.12 = 15.0 g protein, 2.8/0.12 = 23.3 g carbohydrate (all sugars). The page's own rule of thumb 'There are 0.2g carbs in each gram of cream powder' (= 20 g/100 g) is consistent with it. The ingredient line printed on the page is 'Ingredients: Milk', with the seller's explanation that the legal ingredient listing has to say Milk because cream is 100 % milk, and the explicit statement 'This Cream Powder is not the same thing as Milk Powder'; the 53 % fat confirms that - whole milk powder is ~26-28 %.

candidates.equivalence_note: Spray-dried New Zealand dairy cream powder ('comes from NZ grass-fed milk, in a powdered format'), fat ~53 g/100 g of powder - a real cream powder outside the 38-48 % A band (reference 42 %), so class B for the owner to decide. No substitution ratio is stated. The fat % was not printed as text: it was read off the product page's nutrition-panel image, which the seller labels 'Avg qty per 12g powder & 100ml water'.
